title: CyberChef

tagline.fr: Le couteau suisse cyber : encodez, décodez, chiffrez et analysez des données dans votre navigateur
tagline.pt: O canivete suíço cibernético: codifique, decodifique, criptografe e analise dados no navegador
tagline.ja: サイバー版スイスアーミーナイフ。ブラウザでデータのエンコード、デコード、暗号化、解析

tagline.hi: साइबर स्विस आर्मी नाइफ़: अपने ब्राउज़र में डेटा को एन्कोड, डिकोड, एन्क्रिप्ट और विश्लेषण करें

notes: CyberChef runs entirely in your browser and stores nothing on the server, like IT-Tools: there is no login, no database and no volume. Recipes and inputs stay in the browser (and in the page URL when you share a recipe link).
There is no sign-in, so anyone who can reach the site can use it. That is harmless for a static toolbox, but restrict access in front of it if you do not want it public.
The official image is a static build served by unprivileged nginx, which listens on port 8080 (not 80). The 128m floor is generous for nginx serving static files.
Verified live on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 (RC-31): created from the 1-Click Recipes tab, Running, HTTPS, first login and a real-use check passed; every image ref below is in its tested list.
